arcs.title: What the Hollow Gave Back
arcs.summary: Day 2: The Jeep returned at fourteen fourteen with mud past both running boards. The creek crossing was clean at nine seventeen — Christine's line, Steve's angle, winch not deployed. A third mark now sits on the chart, half a mile above the second circle on an unnamed ridge. Steve has four margin words this time. The duck was found at the second waymarker facing due south. The one unexpected thing was carried home in a coat pocket and now sits on the kitchen table; its identity has not yet been disclosed. Day 3 should reveal what the unexpected thing is — something found on the ridge, a feature of the hollow itself, or whatever the duck's reorientation implies — and give Steve's four margin words partial meaning. The Ministry's duck subcommittee may also attempt contact.
